      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "The new check runs after the nTime refresh, causing genuinely newer announcements to be blocked whenever the refresh fires.",
      "quote": "the new check runs *after* the `nTime` refresh above it, which sets `pinfo->nTime = addr.nTime - time_penalty`. So whenever that refresh fires, the check becomes `addr.nTime - time_penalty <= addr.nTi",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author agreed to fix with next push, discussed removing the 1h interval",
      "author_replies": [
        "r:5652371266"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "r:5652371266",
      "status_by_quote": "Good point! I will fix this with the next push (how depends on the discussion below)."
    },
    {
      "id": "c:6206213292",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "Clarify and document the intended behavior around updating timestamps versus increasing multiplicity in AddSingle.",
      "quote": "I think it would be nice to at least have some documentation around this, and the current \"do not update if no new information is present\" comment is not very explicative",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author explained historical context and suggested removing the 1h update interval instead",
      "author_replies": [
        "r:5652371266"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "r:5652371266",
      "status_by_quote": "I think this describes a real inconsistency also present in master: We may update the RefCount for an address, even though we didn't update `nTime`."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4358998250",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "safety",
      "text": "Add a test checking that a relayed newer announcement can still add buckets / bump multiplicity.",
      "quote": "Besides checking that relayed duplicates don’t add buckets, maybe we could also check that a relayed newer announcement still can.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "open",
      "status_note": "",
      "author_replies": [],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "",
      "status_by_quote": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "r:5643014721",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "A relayed announcement more than an hour newer than the previous one can no longer add a bucket, keeping nodes that announce daily at multiplicity 1.",
      "quote": "One issue should be fixed before merge: on 5f58a43fd7, a relayed announcement more than an hour newer than the previous one can no longer add a bucket, so a node that announces itself once a day stays",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author agreed to fix with next push, discussed removing the 1h interval",
      "author_replies": [
        "r:5652371266"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "r:5652371266",
      "status_by_quote": "Good point! I will fix this with the next push (how depends on the discussion below)."
    }
  ],
  "support": [
    {
      "id": "r:5385383947",
      "verdict": "ACK",
      "reason": "onion/i2p-only nodes will have slightly fewer addresses with inflated nRefCount",
      "substantive": true,
